description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git' command line tool, specifically testing the '-C' option and its interactions with other options such as '--git-dir' and '--work-tree'. It defines various test cases to verify expected behaviors of git commands when invoked with different path and directory options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a specific description and script.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository at a specified directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output, used for validating test results.
